package.name: j10_sim
package.description:
Gazebo worlds, ArduPilot SITL parameters and launch files for simulating the J10 vehicle. Per boundary rule 4 in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md this package is never a runtime dependency of anything — it exists only for SITL.
Gazebo itself and the ArduPilot source tree are external prerequisites and are not rosdep keys, so they are documented in README.md rather than declared here.
